assessment.rationale: The static analysis reveals a high-confidence malicious prediction (0.996) from an authoritative LightGBM model, supported by structural indicators of obfuscation and entropy.
limitations: Prediction derived from EMBER feature record rather than raw PE bytes; score is not calibrated probability.
Static analysis cannot confirm runtime behavior or payload functionality.
